settings.title: Settings
settings.protectedDesc: Commands matching these entries require manual approval; everything else runs without asking. Plain entries match the program basename exactly (/bin/rm hits rm); entries with * or ? use shell wildcard syntax against the whole command (e.g. *delete* hits kubectl delete). One entry per line; use * to require approval for all commands.
settings.protectedPlaceholder:
e.g.
rm
kubectl delete*
kubectl apply*
kube delete*
kube apply*
settings.modelsUrlHint: Leave blank to use the host address. Some Anthropic-protocol gateways (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic) do not serve /v1/models — point this at a compatible address instead (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com).
settings.modelStaleHint: Saved, but the gateway's /v1/models no longer returns it. It still takes part in automatic model selection; uncheck to remove.
settings.gitIssueHint: Managed by your system administrator, read-only; per-project config in project settings takes priority.
settings.openModeDesc: How links open from the port forwarding panel. Defaults to reverse proxy.
settings.openModeProxyHint: Server-side forwarding. Easy to use, but apps with absolute paths may render incorrectly.
settings.openModeTunnelHint: Requires some technical skill (running the millet-tunnel CLI). If you are not comfortable with development tooling, prefer Reverse Proxy.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Backfill newly added defaults (e.g. default custom commands) on restart; off keeps the stored config untouched
settings.idleReminderHint: Scan running sessions for inactivity beyond the threshold; sessions in the list become reminder candidates. Turn off to disable entirely
